candidate_scope: concatenated sections.text only; separate citations/header/abstract/tables are not scored
reference_scope: full PDF text emitted by pdftotext; not publisher ground truth or body-only oracle
baseline_scope: NativeFallbackPolicy DATA counterfactual under frozen arm execution map; not literal production parse-pdf route
validation_scope: fixed 80 adaptive diagnostic documents, not untouched final test
throughput_scope: one offline per-arm wall-clock sample including setup/probe/output write; 2 capture processes max; no batch-server capacity claim
min_support_scope: 4 arm observations, typically 2 fully paired independent documents, not 4-document confidence
learned_only: explicit opt-in required; no promotion or graph writes
metric_selection: all8config variants predeclared; no winner metric adopted by validation results
